name: AILinkMaster: Auto Internal Links & SEO
author: aivc

sections.description:
AILinkMaster is a smart solution for WordPress publishers who want to improve SEO via internal linking without manual work. The plugin operates in two powerful modes to ensure maximum performance:

  1. Static (Standard): Links are calculated once and frozen in the database. This ensures zero load on your server for visitors.
  2. Hybrid: Keeps fresh articles dynamic for a set period, then automatically freezes them into Static mode.

Key Features

  • Smart Internal Linking: Automatically link keywords to your money pages or categories.
  • Intelligent Caching: All links are eventually frozen to ensure your site stays fast.
  • 404 Scout (Link Monitor): Find all broken internal links within your site. Vital for webmasters and affiliate marketers to fix dead ends and preserve link juice.
  • Orphans (No Inbound Links): Instantly find posts that have zero internal inbound links.
    • Report includes: Total Articles | Orphan Articles count.
  • Frozen Links Report: Track your automated linking progress.
    • Report includes: Total frozen links | Total unique articles linked to.

Flexible Rules & Logic

AILinkMaster allows for precise control over how and where your links appear:

  • Category Distribution: You can set rules to distribute a percentage of links across different categories. This covers more articles on your site rather than linking everything to a single category.
  • Older (days) & Newer (days): Configured for each rule individually. These settings allow you to target specific content “age” windows, ensuring links are only placed in posts that fall within a certain date range.
  • URL Exclusions: Exclude specific pages from being processed.
    • Example: To exclude the homepage, privacy policy, and about page, enter: *, privacy-policy, about-us (where * represents the homepage).
  • Global & Word Limits: Control diversity by setting a maximum number of links per post and a limit on how many times a specific keyword can be linked.

Pro Features (Coming Soon)

We are working hard on the Pro version, which will include:
* Advanced Keyword Scanner: Deep analysis of your content to find unlinked high-frequency words.
* Extended Statistics: Detailed reports on link performance and site-wide link density.
* AI Suggestions: Automated keyword-to-URL matching using LLMs.

Configuration Guide

🛠 Modes Explained

  • Static (Standard): Links are generated once and saved (“frozen”) in the database.
    • Note: If you change specific Keywords, use the “Unfreeze ALL” button to regenerate old posts.
  • Hybrid: Keeps fresh articles dynamic for X days. After X days, links automatically freeze to save resources.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ailinkmaster-internal-auto-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings -> AILinkMaster to configure your keywords and rules.
sections.faq:
How does Static mode work?

The plugin calculates links based on your rules when the page is first visited. It then saves these links to the DB. On subsequent visits, it serves these saved links instantly.

What is the “Hybrid” mode?

It allows you to test links on new articles dynamically. After a set period (e.g., 30 days), the plugin “freezes” the current link structure for that post.
sections.changelog:
34.1

  • Security Update: Added Nonce verification and SQL preparation for better database safety.
  • Rule Enhancements: Added individual “Older” and “Newer” day settings for rules.
  • Exclusions: Added “URL Exclusions” feature to skip specific pages (including homepage).
  • Reporting: Added Frozen Links Report (Total links/Unique articles) and enhanced Orphan Post reporting.

34.0

  • Major Update: Architecture shift to Static-first approach for better performance.

1.0

  • Initial release.
